description: Defines the RedirectInfo struct and related enums for handling URL redirect information within the net namespace, including policies, redirect details, and static methods for computing redirect info.

classes.name: RedirectInfo
classes.description: Struct capturing information about URL redirects, including status, new URL, method, policies, and flags.

methods.name: ComputeRedirectInfo
methods.description: Static method to compute a new RedirectInfo based on original request properties, redirect response details, and policies.
